per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall reduce avoidable scheduling mistakes by consolidating scheduling and tracking of cohorts, clinical placements, and competency status into a single integrated workflow to stop constant firefighting.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall help the user avoid making mistakes while scheduling classes and clinicals for the nursing students.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall prevent or surface conflicts (e.g., double-booking of preceptors or sites) with built-in checks and block or clearly warn users when a scheduling conflict is detected.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall help the user avoid making mistakes while scheduling classes and clinicals for the nursing students.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: For non-negotiable rules (such as missing prerequisites), the system shall enforce the rule and prevent overrides; for negotiable conflicts (e.g., scheduling collisions), it shall allow authorized overrides but record an audit trail of who overrode and why.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall help the user avoid making mistakes while scheduling classes and clinicals for the nursing students.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide an immutable audit trail and reporting capabilities to show who made schedule changes, overrides, and the reasons, and to produce reports for cohort progression, missing competencies, site utilization, and recurring scheduling conflicts.
The system shall authenticate users via the university's central directory / single sign-on (Banner/central directory) and avoid separate logins for staff.
The system shall synchronize student enrollment and identity data with the university Student Information System (Banner) to avoid manual retyping and ensure data consistency.

The system shall implement role-based access control so program administrators and designated nursing faculty have full access to student records, while site coordinators, instructors, and others see only role-appropriate views and contact/qualification info.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: Only authorized users shall have access to students' personal information.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall comply with the university information policy for protection of student records and health information (FERPA/HIPAA-equivalent controls as required by the university).
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The system shall protect private information in accordance with the organization's information policy.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Small interactive operations (e.g., opening a student profile or updating a status) shall respond within approximately 5 seconds to feel 'snappy' to users.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The response time of general student management tasks shall take no longer than 5 seconds and the response time of schedule generation shall take no longer than 30 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Complex operations (e.g., generating an entire term schedule) shall complete within 30 seconds under expected peak load to avoid staff reverting to manual processes.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The response time of general student management tasks shall take no longer than 5 seconds and the response time of schedule generation shall take no longer than 30 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall handle concurrent use by multiple administrators (typical peak around 10 concurrent users) without degrading responsiveness for the defined performance targets.
The system shall be available during business hours (weekdays approximately 08:00–18:00) and support off-hour maintenance only; acceptable availability target is approximately 95% over the term.
Maintenance windows shall be scheduled outside of business hours to avoid disrupting scheduling activities.

The system shall send automated notifications (email or in-app) to appropriate audiences when schedules change, with defaults automated but allowing targeting of message audience; triggering notifications shall be restricted to program admins and lead coordinators.
The system shall allow quick contingency replanning workflows to suggest alternate sites that meet constraints when last-minute cancellations occur, enabling staff to reassign students rapidly.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall help the user avoid making mistakes while scheduling classes and clinicals for the nursing students.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall integrate with credential verification systems so sites can view only necessary credential information about students.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: Only authorized users shall have access to students' personal information.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide onboarding and user interfaces that are easy to learn such that most program admins can be productive after a single day-long training session; acceptable adoption is two-thirds (2/3) of admins able to perform core scheduling tasks independently after that training.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: '2 out of 3 Program Administrators/Nursing Staff Members shall successfully be able to use the system to manage the scheduling of classes and clinicals.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall provide reporting and monitoring metrics including monthly uptime, user satisfaction, and counts of scheduling errors to measure success after launch.
The system shall produce rosters suitable for sending to clinical sites quickly prior to each clinical rotation (exportable in common formats and accessible to authorized site admins).
The system shall limit the ability to trigger mass notifications to program admins and lead coordinators via role-based permissions to avoid accidental mass communications.

The system shall be reliable and usable such that if it is too slow or confusing, staff will not resort to emails and spreadsheets; student privacy shall not be compromised—these are non-negotiable constraints.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The system shall be easy to use by the Program Administrators/Nursing Staff Members.'
